# FundedLot

> FundedLot: Prop Firm Signals (also written "Funded Lot") is an iOS and Android app with
> trading signals for forex, gold and silver, US indices and crypto. Each signal has an entry,
> a stop loss and three targets (TP1-TP3), and the app sizes it for the member's account and
> their prop firm's daily loss and max loss limits. AI signals are posted at the live price
> and kept on a public record with every win and loss. Members also get a 1:1 mentor, an AI
> coach, and free prop firm challenge practice on virtual funds. Signals arrive in the app and
> in a Telegram room. People sign in and save their trading plan on the website; the
> subscription (FundedLot Mentorship, monthly or yearly) is bought in the app through the App
> Store or Google Play. FundedLot is not a broker, holds no client money, offers no funded
> accounts or payouts, and is not affiliated with any prop firm. Signals are educational
> analysis, not financial advice.

## Signals
- [Trading signals](https://www.fundedlot.com/signals/): every market and platform, the public AI record, a sizing calculator
- [Prop firm signals](https://www.fundedlot.com/prop-firm-signals/): signals sized to FTMO-style daily loss and max loss rules
- [Forex signals](https://www.fundedlot.com/signals/forex/): EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, USD/CAD
- [Gold & silver signals](https://www.fundedlot.com/signals/gold/): XAU/USD (gold), XAG/USD (silver)
- [Indices signals](https://www.fundedlot.com/signals/indices/): US30 (Dow 30), NAS100 (Nasdaq 100), SPX500 (S&P 500)
- [Crypto signals](https://www.fundedlot.com/signals/crypto/): BTC/USD, ETH/USD, SOL/USD
- [Get the app](https://www.fundedlot.com/get/): opens the right store on a phone

## Product
- [How it works](https://www.fundedlot.com/how-it-works/): the practice loop — pick rules, trade, read the autopsy, retry
- [Features](https://www.fundedlot.com/features/): rules engine, risk guard, mistake detectors, readiness score
- [Pricing](https://www.fundedlot.com/pricing/): free tier and the one subscription, FundedLot Mentorship, bought in the app
- [Mentorship](https://www.fundedlot.com/mentor/): signals sized to your rules, a 1:1 mentor, the AI coach and a money-back guarantee
- [Download](https://www.fundedlot.com/download/): App Store and Google Play availability
- [FundedLot on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fundedlot-prop-firm-practice/id6806785387): the iPhone app
- [FundedLot on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.myindianow.fundedlot): the Android app
- [FAQ](https://www.fundedlot.com/faq/): common questions, answered plainly
